metrics:

text: Mina was great to work with on our warehouse models project. She built a solid dbt project with staging, intermediate, and mart layers for orders, subscriptions, and marketing, and kept things moving smoothly in BigQuery, Fivetran, and SQL. We ended up with 38 models and tests on 120 columns, and our dashboard refresh went from daily to hourly. Would hire again.
